note: Cautious posture maintained. The FOMC held rates at 3.50-3.75% on July 29 with three dissenters wanting hikes; markets now price two additional 25-bps hikes in 2026, making the rate environment a headwind for equity valuations. Core PCE inflation at 3.29% remains 129 bps above the Fed's 2% target after more than five years above target. Q2 2026 GDP of +1.5% came in below expectations and below Q1's +2.09%, signaling a softening economy. The 10-year Treasury yield at 4.67% provides meaningful competition to equity earnings yields. The S&P 500 trades at roughly 25-29x trailing earnings — expensive relative to the ~18x historical median. Peak earnings season delivered divergent results this week: MSFT and AMZN rewarded for cloud and AI execution; META and AAPL punished despite beating on reported numbers (investors skeptical of AI strategy and ROI). Geopolitical risk remains: US-Iran conflict is active and volatile; Brent crude near $86 and up ~20% in July despite energy price dip in June. Futures point modestly higher this morning but that reflects earnings optimism in cloud names, not an improvement in the fundamental backdrop. None of our three thesis candidates (AAPL $302.50, MSFT $454.75, V $365.29) are near any buyable threshold at any margin of safety. Cautious posture: demand a wider discount before any new buy; hold cash.
